definitions.first_trial_boundary: first_trial_end_step from evidence readout; first physical recovery action starts this step
definitions.initial_planning: backend ready until first action; includes first observation service and non-RPC wall
definitions.first_grasp: all physical steps and backend action service before first recovery; includes setup, close and lift verification
definitions.release_retreat: after first recovery begins: s3_*, s7_release*, or phase containing release/retreat
definitions.replanning: all non-RPC wall after first recovery boundary plus observation-only backend requests; includes visual inference, IK, checks, scheduler/IPC idle; not pure CPU
definitions.regrasp: remaining physical steps and action service after first recovery; includes local/preload recovery and retry approach, closure and lift
definitions.wall_scope: stages add exactly to backend ready-to-finish monotonic span; startup_and_finalize is the remaining end-to-end batch wall
definitions.missing: invalid/incomplete timing is reported and excluded only from timing summaries, never success denominators; recovered scheduler wall is excluded only from exact batch/startup wall summaries, completed backend and physics stages retained
definitions.percentile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.9; per-episode statistics, zero-duration stages included
